# @arki/dot

> The app kernel for `@arki`: typed plugins, a 5-hook lifecycle (`configure`, `boot`, `start`, `stop`, `dispose`), features as a chain, and a JSON CLI (`dot new`, `dot explain`, `dot doctor`, `dot dev`). It is not a web server, an ORM or a DI container; adapters live in other packages.

Wrong wiring is a compile error at `.use()`. Read `.data` from the CLI's JSON: it IS the manifest (`explain`) or the diagnostics snapshot (`doctor`).

## Import paths
- `@arki/dot`: `defineApp`, `plugin`, `service`, `token`, `lazy`, `rename`, `hookSignals`, `testApp`, `testPlugin`, `fake`; types `Provided`, `NeedsShape`, `DotAppManifest`, `DotDiagnosticsSnapshot`.
- `@arki/dot/plugin`: the adapter-author surface: `plugin`, `handleOf`, `lazy`, `token`, `rename`, `defineApp`, contract types.
- `@arki/dot/feature`: `defineFeature`, `DepsOf`, `routerFor`, `entrypointOnly`, `providesOf`, `servicesOf`, `resolveNeeds`, `ServicesBag`; object-form `feature()`.
- `@arki/dot/orpc`: `needsMiddleware`, `rpc`. Optional peer `@orpc/server`.
- `@arki/dot/log`: `log()`, the logging plugin. Mount it first.
- `@arki/dot/runtime`: `createAppRuntime(app, { hot })`, one started app per server process; waits for the old app's dispose on a Vite hot update.
- `@arki/dot/test-harness`: `testPlugin`, `testApp`, `bootTestApp`, `fake`.
- `@arki/dot/cli`: `program` (built with `@arki/cli`; `program.main(argv, io)`), `runExplain`, `runDoctor`, `runNew`, the failures `AppNotFound`, `AppInvalidExport`, `AppImportFailed`, `AppLifecycleFailed`, `DoctorFailed`, `ObservabilityNoSdk`, `ProjectionNotFound`, `ProjectionImportFailed`, `ProjectionExecutionFailed`, `ProjectionConflict`, `TargetNotEmpty`, `TemplateMissing`, `WriteFailed`; types `DotNewResult`, `DotNewOperation`, `DoctorReport`. The `dot` bin: `arki.cli/1` envelope, exit 0/1/2/3.

## Rules that bite
- `.data` is the payload. There is no `.data.manifest` and no `.data.diagnostics`.
- `dot explain` only configures. `dot doctor` boots and disposes; it never calls `start()`.
- `configure` is sync and does no I/O. `boot` returns nothing; values go in `provides`.
- Providers come before consumers. The wrong order is a compile error, or `ARKI_DOT_E020`.
- A second instance of a plugin needs `rename`, or its keys collide (`ARKI_DOT_E013`).
- Do not cast an app to read its manifest. Call `.configure().manifest`.
- `@arki/dot` never imports its adapters (`@arki/env/dot`, `@arki/db/dot`, `@arki/kv/dot`, `@arki/journal/dot`).
